em_gamp_zhao2025.paper: Joint Activity Detection and Channel Estimation in Mixed-Fronthaul Cell-Free Massive MIMO
em_gamp_zhao2025.authors: T. Zhao, S. Chen, H.-H. Chen, Q. Guo

source_formula_resolution.beta: Eq.(38) stationary EM condition with derivative Eq.(39); conditional second moment. Printed Eq.(40) incorrectly includes posterior support probability; separately audited.
source_formula_resolution.detector: Exact log-density ratio of Eq.(51),(55); log determinant ratio. Printed gamma=log(det Sigma_1-det Sigma_0) following Eq.(56) is inconsistent.
source_formula_resolution.complex: Modulus squared and conjugate transpose required by the explicitly proper-complex model; several intermediate printed real scalar expressions omit these.

adaptation.quantization: native full-resolution special case alpha_m=1, Eq.(6), noise Eq.(49)
adaptation.mmv: antenna columns replace AP columns; dictionary columns replace flat-fading pilot columns
adaptation.user_detector: Eq.(51) Gaussian log likelihoods summed over each user delay-Doppler block under diagonal covariance; no Ding energy threshold and no prior-odds addition
adaptation.effective_covariance: GAMP pseudo variance nu^r estimates Eq.(52) effective diagonal covariance; no true-channel MSE or oracle path support
adaptation.initialization: public activity_prior initializes global lambda; per-column observation energy initializes beta and noise; paper does not publish numeric q initialization
adaptation.iterations: fixed Tmax=1000 is an explicit project budget; no numerical Tmax or early-stop tolerance is published in Zhao Algorithm 1
adaptation.zero_mean: native Eq.(3), not a project simplification
adaptation.posterior_support: scalar probabilities averaged across rows/columns by Eq.(36); no shared-row BG posterior replacement
